messages:
maria: Quick async check — we're ready to start a narrow rollout for structured-output + function-calling behavior, but need alignment on flag scopes and client SDK expectations.

kai: Proposed plan: flip server flag `so_fncall_enable` in two stages — 5% hosted traffic (non-enterprise) day 1, 25% day 3 if no regressions. Dedicated remains off until we validate latency.

tom: +1. For client SDKs, let's default to compat_mode = true. New opt-in param `structured_output: 'strict'` for customers who want exact schema enforcement.

sara: Can we make that opt-in available in the JS SDK by adding `structuredOutput: 'strict'` in request options? Example: `await client.chat.generate({prompt, structuredOutput: 'strict'})`

kai: Yes; SDKs should map `structuredOutput` to the header `x-rw-so-mode: strict` so we don't have to change server payload parsing.

alan: Guardrails: auto-fallback to non-structured output if model returns unparsable JSON 3x in a row for a user session. Also rate-limit rollback if error budget consumed >0.5%.

jess: For canary audiences — please restrict to apps tagged `so-experiment` and exclude any orgs with PII processing until we finish KMS integration.

maria: Good catch. I'll update the rollout sheet (link: https://docs.internal/rw/so-rollout) with `so-experiment` whitelist and add a note about KMS exclusion.

tom: PR open for SDK: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/402 — needs one more review. CI flaky on windows lint, but unit tests pass.

sara: @tom I'll take the SDK review after stand. Also can we add an integration test that asserts header mapping? Simple curl: 
```
curl -H 'x-rw-so-mode: strict' \
  -d '{"prompt":"..."}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

kai: Server patch deployed to staging. Running synthetic evals against prompt set `so-smoke-v2`. So far structure accuracy 94% and median latency +18ms.

deploy-bot: canary started (hosted 5% — cohort `so-experiment`). Monitoring channels: #so-monitoring, #incidents.

alan: Heads-up — add metric `so.parsing_failures` and an alert if rate > 0.2% over 5m.

maria: Next steps: SDK roll merged + npm publish, infra tag for canary, post-mortem doc template in the rollout sheet. If no objections by EOD I'll start the scheduled enable.

kai: No objections from infra. I'm oncall if anything pops.

jess: noted and I'll validate no PII orgs in the first wave.

sara: LGTM — proceeding with review and will ping once merged :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks all — ping here with any late issues. We'll reconvene async tomorrow to decide expansion to dedicated.
